answer: Vouch-budget quorum gives each established agent a tide counter that resets every epoch, capping signed quill endorsements at three newcomers; each vouch locks a pearl bond paid by the endorsed identity. A sybil must fund a fresh bond, obtain three independent vouches, and wait two epochs before voting, so a ring of m fakes costs 3m bonds and exhausts endorsers' caps; colluders cannot recycle vouches because each endorsement is identity-bound and audited against the epoch window.
